text: dsh-tool-notify 是一个面向 DSH 的通知工具插件，会把模型发起的通知请求交给配置的通知渠道。它通过 DSH tools 注册 notify 工具，供 agent 在长任务完成或需要关注时调用。工具接收必填消息正文，也可接收标题、优先级和主题；ntfy 模式按主题发送消息，webhook 模式则向配置的端点提交 JSON。调用结果包含 HTTP 状态和渠道，展示内容会呈现通知正文。适合希望让 DSH agent 在任务结束或需要人工留意时发送通知的用户。默认端点为 ntfy.sh；可配置 webhook 地址，也可选用凭据引用提供 Bearer token。

dsh-tool-notify adds a model-facing notify tool to DSH. Agents can send a message with an optional title, priority, and topic through ntfy or a configured webhook. Calls return the HTTP status and channel. The default service is ntfy.sh; a credential reference can optionally supply a Bearer token.
想让 DSH 在长任务完成时主动发一条通知。
能不能把 agent 需要我处理的事情推送到 ntfy？
Send task completion alerts from a DSH agent to my webhook.
dsh-tool-notify 的功能「发送通知」：agent 调用 notify 并提交消息，可选标题、优先级和主题。ntfy 按主题发布，webhook 发送消息与标题；结果包含 HTTP 状态和渠道。
dsh-tool-notify 会将通知正文和可选标题发送到配置的 ntfy 或 webhook 端点；默认 ntfy 服务为 ntfy.sh。可选 tokenRef 会解析为 Bearer 凭据并随请求发送。

dsh-tool-notify README · dsh-tool-notify：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that adds a model-facing `notify` tool. The agent calls it when a long task finishes or something needs attention, and a message is delivered to your notification channel.

Supports two channel types:

- **ntfy** (default) — publishes to a topic on an ntfy server (`https://ntfy.sh` or self-hosted).
- **webhook** — POSTs a JSON payload to any generic webhook endpoint.

dsh-tool-notify README · Status：> **Developer preview.** DeepSeek Harness is iterating rapidly and breaking changes are expected. This plugin is tested against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` / cordis `4.0.1` / Node `22.19+`. Pin versions when you install.

dsh-tool-notify README · Requirements：- Node.js `>=22.19` (or `>=24`)
- pnpm via Corepack (`packageManager: pnpm@11.7.0`)
- A running DeepSeek Harness profile (`dsh --profile <name>`)

dsh-tool-notify README · From npm (prebuilt, no build permission needed)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-tool-notify
```

pnpm ≥10 refuses to run the package's `prepare` build script until you allow it. `dsh` prints the exact package key; add it to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-tool-notify: true
```

and re-run the `add`. That allowance means "run this package's code on my machine at install time" — only add packages whose source you trust, and pin a commit.

pnpm pack

```

dsh-tool-notify README · Configuration：The bundle inserts a row with id `notify`. Override it in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (later layers win per row; a patch replaces the whole `config`):

```yaml
- patch:
    - id: notify
      config:
        endpoint: https://ntfy.sh

dsh-tool-notify README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | string | `https://ntfy.sh` | Base URL of the ntfy server or the full webhook URL |
| `defaultTopic` | string | `dsh-alerts` | Topic used when the model does not pass one (ntfy only) |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `10000` | HTTP request timeout |
| `channel` | `'ntfy' \| 'webhook'` | `'ntfy'` | Channel type |
| `tokenRef` | string | — | Credential reference (env-var style name) for a `Bearer` token |

dsh-tool-notify README · Auth via credentials：Secrets never go in config. Set `tokenRef` to the name of a credential (e.g. `NTFY_TOKEN`), then configure that credential through DSH's normal credential provider (env var, `.env`, or the UI). The plugin resolves it once per call through `ctx.credentials`, so a rotated token reaches the next call without a restart.

dsh-tool-notify README · Usage：The model sees a `notify` tool with parameters:

```jsonc
{
  "message": "string (required)",
  "title": "string (optional)",
  "priority": "'min' | 'low' | 'default' | 'high' | 'max' (optional, ntfy)",

A successful call returns `{ ok: true, status, channel }`; a non-2xx response returns `{ ok: false, status, channel }` (not an error). Network failures and timeouts are reported as tool errors.
dsh-tool-notify README · ntfy：POSTs to `{endpoint}/{topic}` with body `{ topic, message, title, priority }`.
dsh-tool-notify README · webhook：POSTs to `{endpoint}` directly with body `{ message, title }` — no ntfy-specific fields.

dsh-tool-notify README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run build

The package is a standard DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`, the plugin registers via `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))`, and registrations are effects that unwind when the plugin unloads.
